# Remote Work Policy

## Eligibility
Employees who have completed the probation period of 90 days may work from home up to three days per week, subject to manager approval.

## Equipment
Each remote employee receives a one-time stipend of $500 to buy home office equipment such as a desk chair or monitor. The company provides the laptop.

## Security
All remote work must be done over the corporate VPN. Confidential documents must never be printed at home.

## Core Hours
Remote employees must be reachable between 10:00 and 15:00 local time.
